spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Mission: Science compels us to explode the sun!
spirals.zh: PYE: Mission: Science compels us to explode the sun!

spirals.speaker: IDAEA
spirals.text: Can’t we change this? I don’t enjoy working in view of such a morbid mission statement.
spirals.zh: IDAEA: Can’t we change this? I don’t enjoy working in view of such a morbid mission statement.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: But it’s accurate. We’re going to create a supernova for the purpose of scientific progress. That’s our mission.
spirals.zh: PYE: But it’s accurate. We’re going to create a supernova for the purpose of scientific progress. That’s our mission.

spirals.speaker: IDAEA
spirals.text: Our mission is to decide if such an irresponsible feat is even possible.
spirals.zh: IDAEA: Our mission is to decide if such an irresponsible feat is even possible.

spirals.speaker: IDAEA
spirals.text: Here’s a better one. Mission: Determine if it’s possible to prompt the sun to explode.
spirals.zh: IDAEA: Here’s a better one. Mission: Determine if it’s possible to prompt the sun to explode.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: You lack a sense of humour.
spirals.zh: PYE: You lack a sense of humor.

spirals.speaker: IDAEA
spirals.text: At least I don’t lack a sense of ethics!
spirals.zh: IDAEA: At least I don’t lack a sense of ethics!

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Kindly refrain from going supernova on me before the sun does, Idaea.
spirals.zh: PYE: Kindly refrain from going supernova on me before the sun does, Idaea.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: What happened? Did the Sun Station not fire?
spirals.zh: YARROW: What happened? Did the Sun Station not fire?

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: It fired, Yarrow. But it failed. The sun barely responded; there were infinitesimally small surface-level changes, but they were barely visible, even to the third eye.
spirals.zh: PYE: It fired, Yarrow. But it failed. The sun barely responded; there were infintestimally small surface-level changes, but they were barely visible, even to the third eye.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: The Sun Station is useless. It will never, and *could* never, cause the sun to explode.
spirals.zh: PYE: The Sun Station is useless. It will never, and could never, cause the sun to explode.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: I don’t know what comes next, my friends. I suppose we must start over, but I’m unsure how to start over.
spirals.zh: PYE: I don’t know what comes next, my friends. I suppose we must start over, but I’m unsure how to start over.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Pye… I hurt for you, my friends; we all know how hard you’ve both worked. I can only offer my compassion. How are you? How is Idaea?
spirals.zh: YARROW: Pye... I hurt for you, my friends; we all know how hard you’ve both worked. I can only offer my compassion. How are you? How is Idaea?

spirals.speaker: IDAEA
spirals.text: We’re well, Yarrow (Or as well as can be expected, given the circumstances), though disappointed. I may have disagreed with the exploding of the sun, but I never wished the device would fail. I’d hoped our terrible work was finished.
spirals.zh: IDAEA: We’re well, Yarrow (or as well as can be expected, given the circumstances), though disappointed. I may have disagreed with exploding the sun, but I never wished the device would fail. I’d hoped our terrible work was finished.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Return to Ash Twin first, my friend. Perhaps a change of task would help: Spire noticed a comet approaching this star system that we’d like to investigate.
spirals.zh: YARROW: Return to Ash Twin first, my friend. Perhaps a change of task would help: Spire noticed a comet approaching this star system that we’d like to investigate.

spirals.speaker: ANNONA
spirals.text: We need status reports for all systems, but initial things first: Is everyone unharmed?
spirals.zh: ANNONA: We need status reports for all systems, but initial things first: Is everyone unharmed?

spirals.speaker: RHUS
spirals.text: Our escape pod's passengers are afraid, but physically well, Annona; everyone survived the crash.
spirals.zh: RHUS: Our escape pod’s passengers are afraid, but physically well, Annona; everyone survived the crash.

spirals.speaker: ANNONA
spirals.text: This is a relief, at least. You have my gratitude. Bur, were you able to find the other escape pod's distress signals?
spirals.zh: ANNONA: This is a relief, at least. You have my gratitude. Bur, were you able to find the other escape pods’ distress signals?

spirals.speaker: BUR
spirals.text: I can hear both signals somewhere in this star system, but I don't believe either escape pod crashed on the same planet as us.
spirals.zh: BUR: I can hear both signals somewhere in this star system, but I don’t believe either escape pod crashed on the same planet as us.

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: The heat from this star system's sun is more bearable beneath the surface.
spirals.zh: 梅洛瑞：在地表下面，这个星系的太阳辐射出的热量还算可以忍受。

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: When our escape pod punctured this planet’s surface, it broke into what scans show is a cave system with much cooler air. I *woul*d recommend we seek a site down there to build a long-term shelter, Annona, but these passages are a maze!
spirals.zh: 梅洛瑞：我们的逃生舱砸穿了这颗星球的地表。扫描显示它闯入了一片洞穴系统，里面的空气凉爽许多。安诺纳，我建议我们在那儿找个地方建立长期庇护所，但那些通道实在是错综复杂！

spirals.speaker: ANNONA
spirals.text: Even with this danger, they are still our best chance for survival. We'll form teams and descend into the caves to look for a shelter site. We can mark our findings on the wall to avoid becoming irreversibly lost.
spirals.zh: 安诺纳：即便存在这样的危险，那里仍然是我们生存的最佳选择。我们将分组深入洞窟，寻找适合建造庇护所的地点。我们可以把发现的东西标记在墙上，以免彻底迷失。

spirals.speaker: ANNONA
spirals.text: Be cautious, everyone.
spirals.zh: 安诺纳：各位多加小心。

spirals.speaker: RHUS
spirals.text: And be aware of the sand as you search. It appears to be rising gradually.
spirals.zh: 鲁斯：搜寻时也要留意沙子。它看起来在慢慢上涨。

spirals.speaker: RHUS
spirals.text: Keep moving, friends: there is nothing of interest at the end of this passage but rocks.
spirals.zh: 鲁斯：继续前进，朋友们：这条通道的尽头除了岩石，没什么特别的。

spirals.speaker: RHUS
spirals.text: And while these rocks are interesting, they can wait until a less urgent time.
spirals.zh: 鲁斯：就算这些岩石确实特别，也可以等到不那么紧急的时候再说。

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: Do not follow this tunnel to its end! (Coleus and I will examine the horror that lies at its terminus later, provided we live through this.)
spirals.zh: 梅洛瑞：不要沿着这条隧道走到底！（假如我们能够活下来的话，科利耶斯和我稍后会去检查一下隧道尽头的那个可怕东西。）

spirals.speaker: ANNONA
spirals.text: Of note: This passage leads to breathable air. Refill your supply tank there (we cannot tell how far or deep these tunnels may wind), but do not linger, as the area is exposed to the heat of this alien sun.
spirals.zh: 安诺纳：注意：这条通道通向可呼吸的空气。在那里补充你的供气罐（我们不清楚这些蜿蜒的隧道究竟延伸多远或多深），但不要久留——那片区域暴露在这颗外星太阳的热辐射之下。

spirals.speaker: ANNONA
spirals.text: Refill your air supply tank and return quickly.
spirals.zh: 安诺纳：充填你的供气罐，然后赶紧回来。

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: We have found an enormous cavern at the end of this passage that appears promising! I believe we could construct long-term shelter here.
spirals.zh: MELORAE: We have found an enormous cavern at the end of this passage that appears promising! I believe we could construct long-term shelter there.

spirals.speaker: ANNONA
spirals.text: The cavern Melorae found is a wise choice for shelter. Could one of you mark directions for the others to follow?
spirals.zh: ANNONA: The cavern Melorae found is a wise choice for shelter. Could one of you mark directions for the others to follow?

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: This is the start of the path to the shelter site. I've left directions to guide you there.
spirals.zh: COLEUS: This is the start of the path to the shelter site. I've left directions to guide you there.

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: Of note: We must hurry, as the pathway there is filling with sand. Do not allow yourself to be buried by sand, and make sure no one is lost!
spirals.zh: MELORAE: Of note: We must hurry, as the pathway there is filling with sand. Do not allow yourself to be buried by sand, and make sure no one is lost!

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: The path to the shelter site is somewhat convoluted, so follow the instructions ahead closely!
spirals.zh: 科利耶斯：通往庇护所的路有些迂回，因此请务必按照前方的指示行动！

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: To reach the shelter site, walk forward until you meet the sandfall at the pit, then turn left. Continue to the room filled with rock column formations and climb upward through the opening above them.
spirals.zh: 科利耶斯：要抵达庇护所，请一直往前走，直到遇到坑洞里的流沙瀑布，然后向左转。进入布满石柱的洞室，从石柱上方的开口向上爬出去。

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: The sand here is rising, so you must be cautious but swift.
spirals.zh: 科利耶斯：这里的沙子正在不断上涨，所以你必须多加小心，但是行动要迅速。

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: Be cautious crossing the chasm ahead. The bridge Melorae and I crafted will do its job, but it isn't strong.
spirals.zh: 科利耶斯：穿越前方沟壑时务必留神。我和梅洛瑞搭的桥能让你过去，但不够牢固。

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: Once on the far side, look for the tunnel hidden behind the falling sand. Follow it, and you'll reach the shelter site.
spirals.zh: 科利耶斯：到对岸后，去找藏在流沙瀑布后面的通道。沿着通道一直往前走，你就可以抵达庇护所。

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: You're doing well! There's only a little farther left to go now until you reach the shelter site. You can rest there. Hurry, before the sand comes!
spirals.zh: 科利耶斯：你做得非常好！只要再坚持一下，庇护所马上就要到了。你可以在那里休息。快走，不然沙子就要来了！

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: This is amazing (look inside the cave)! How did this come to rest here? We haven't encountered others in these caves; I think this is a rare find.
spirals.zh: MELORAE: This is amazing (look inside the cave)! How did this come to rest here? We haven’t encountered others in these caves; I think this is a rare find.

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: From what we can see, Coleus and I believe the specimen must be very old indeed. Imagine what we might learn if we could examine it!
spirals.zh: MELORAE: From what we can see, Coleus and I believe the specimen must be very old indeed. Imagine what we might learn if we could examine it!

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: We both believe it's unlikely this dry planet is this horror's place of origin (especially considering what we observed during the Vessel's evacuation).
spirals.zh: COLEUS: We both agree it’s unlikely this dry planet is this horror’s place of origin (especially considering what we observed during the Vessel’s evacuation).

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: Clearly this hole is too small for it to have fit through. Hypothesis: There is another entrance to this cave. If there is, Coleus and I will find it! We can't leave valuable information undiscovered!
spirals.zh: MELORAE: Clearly this hole is too small for it to have fit through. Hypothesis: There is another entrance to this cave. If there is, Coleus and I will find it! We can’t leave valuable information undiscovered!

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: An update: We need to find a way inside quickly, Melorae, because when I returned here to search for an entrance to the cave, there were children playing on the specimen!
spirals.zh: COLEUS: An update: We need to find a way inside quickly, Melorae, because when I returned here to search for an entrance to the cave, there were children playing on the specimen!

spirals.text: Should we build the Sun Station in order to power the Ash Twin Project?
spirals.zh: 我们要不要建造太阳站来为灰烬双星计划提供动力？

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Are there other ways to generate this level of power?
spirals.zh: 亚罗：还有没有其他办法能产生这种级别的能量？

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Theoretically, yes. Practically, no. I can't imagine discovering them in our lifetimes…
spirals.zh: 派伊：理论上，有。实际上，没有。我无法想象我们能在这一生中发现那样的方法……

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: I understand this proposal is unsettling, but the Sun Station must be built if we hope to complete the Ash Twin Project.
spirals.zh: 瑞米：我知道这个提议令人不安，但如果我们打算完成灰烬双星计划，就必须建造太阳站。

spirals.speaker: IDAEA
spirals.text: I almost can't comprehend this is being suggested seriously. The purpose of the Sun Station goes against every standard we hold ourselves to and everything we believe in as a species!
spirals.zh: 伊代亚：我简直难以理解提出这种建议的人是认真的。太阳站的功能完全违背了我们秉持的所有准则，以及我们作为一个物种所坚信的一切！

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Unsurprisingly, Idaea, I disagree. We're pushing a possible new technology further than ever before. That, in my experience, is the defining characteristic of our species.
spirals.zh: 派伊：毫不意外，伊代亚，我不同意你的看法。我们正在将一项史无前例的新技术推进到前所未有的高度。而这，以我的经验，正是定义我们这一物种的特征。

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: If we fail (and the probability of this is not insignificant), we will without question destroy ourselves, all life here, and the rest of this star system. I wish to protect these species.
spirals.zh: 科利耶斯：如果我们失败了（而这种可能性并不算小），毫无疑问，我们会摧毁自己、这里所有的生命，以及这个星系的其余一切。我想保护这些物种。

spirals.speaker: IDAEA
spirals.text: The potential annihilation of and not entirely star system is too severe a cost. We shouldn't build the Sun Station, no matter how badly we want the knowledge that comes with it.
spirals.zh: 伊代亚：可能毁灭整个星系，这个代价太沉重了。无论我们多么渴望随之而来的知识，都不该建造太阳站。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Fear of failure is a poor reason not to try. I believe, if we're cautious, the Sun Station will work. I believe in Pye.
spirals.zh: 珀克：害怕失败绝非拒绝尝试的借口。我相信，只要我们谨慎行事，太阳站会成功的。我相信派伊。

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Poke, I'm deeply honoured. Idaea, I comprehend your position; however, if we aren't all but certain the Sun Station will not cause destruction once we've built it, then I won't support the station's use.
spirals.zh: 派伊：珀克，我深感荣幸。伊代亚，我理解你的立场；不过，如果在建成之后，我们不能近乎百分百确定太阳站不会造成毁灭，那么我也不会支持使用它。

spirals.speaker: TAGET
spirals.text: Are we playing the fossil fish game tonight?
spirals.zh: 塔格特：今天晚上我们玩不玩化石鱼游戏？

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: I fed the fossil fish a new lantern. If you go to the Stepping Stone Cave, the entrance to the Fossil Fish Cave is easy to see now.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我给化石鱼喂了一盏新灯。现在去垫脚石洞那儿，很容易就能看到化石鱼洞的入口了。

spirals.speaker: LAEVI
spirals.text: Gratitude, Solanum! It's good you're small enough to climb through the hole at the Anglerfish Overlook.
spirals.zh: 莱阿维：谢谢你，所莱内姆！幸好你还小，能从安康鱼瞭望台的洞里钻进去。

spirals.speaker: LAMI
spirals.text: I'm still small enough!
spirals.zh: 拉米：我也还够小！

spirals.speaker: LAEVI
spirals.text: You won't be for long. Mom and dad are tall, so you and I will be tall, too.
spirals.zh: 莱阿维：不会太久了。妈妈和爸爸都很高，所以你和我也会很高的。

spirals.speaker: LAEVI
spirals.text: We're meeting in the Fossil Fish Cave to play the game! If you're not too big to climb through the Anglerfish Overlook hole:
spirals.zh: 莱阿维：我们约好在化石鱼洞穴玩游戏！如果你太大了，钻不进安康鱼瞭望台的洞口的话：

spirals.speaker: LAEVI
spirals.text: You'll have to go the long way, but it isn't far. Go to the Stepping Stone Cave, then up and into the Fossil Fish Cave.
spirals.zh: 莱阿维：你就得绕远路了，不过也不太远。去垫脚石洞，然后往上走就能进入化石鱼洞了。

spirals.speaker: TAGET
spirals.text: I tried to get to the Fossil Fish Cave through the Stepping Stone Cave, but I couldn't find the entrance. Where is it?
spirals.zh: 塔格特：我试着从垫脚石洞那边找化石鱼，但是找不到入口。它在哪里？

spirals.speaker: ILEX
spirals.text: Remember to feed the fossil fish first! If you go into the Anglerfish Overlook and throw a light into his mouth, he'll show you the way.
spirals.zh: 艾莱克斯：记得先去喂化石鱼！去安康鱼瞭望台，往他的嘴里扔一盏灯，他就会给你指路的。

spirals.speaker: LAMI
spirals.text: Taget can't fit through the Anglerfish Overlook hole anymore because he grew bigger! He's taller than Laevi now.
spirals.zh: 拉米：塔格特没法穿过安康鱼瞭望台了，因为他长大了！他现在比莱阿维还高呢。

spirals.speaker: LAEVI
spirals.text: Who cares? Ilex is still the tallest.
spirals.zh: 莱阿维：那又怎么样？个子最高的还是艾莱克斯。

spirals.text: Who's been computing shuttle trajectories to the Sun Station? Don't worry; the station is in such a low stellar orbit, we've constructed a different, safer way to travel there from Ash Twin.
spirals.zh: Who’s been computing shuttle trajectories to the Sun Station? Don’t worry; the station is in such a low stellar orbit, we’ve constructed a different, safer way to travel there from Ash Twin.

spirals.speaker: IDAEA
spirals.text: That would be Pye. I told her we wouldn't be travelling there by shuttle, and that the Sun Station doesn't even have a landing pad, but she said she knew.
spirals.zh: IDAEA: That would be Pye. I told her we wouldn’t be traveling there by shuttle, and that the Sun Station doesn’t even have a landing pad, but she said she knew.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: It's a purely theoretical exercise on my part, Yarrow. Who doesn't love computing a good low stellar orbit shuttle trajectory!
spirals.zh: PYE: It’s a purely theoretical exercise on my part, Yarrow. Who doesn’t love computing a good low stellar orbit shuttle trajectory!

spirals.speaker: IDAEA
spirals.text: Pye, I look forward to working with you, but I'm also relieved it will be easy to return to Ash Twin regularly.
spirals.zh: IDAEA: Pye, I look forward to working with you, but I’m also relieved it will be easy to return to Ash Twin regularly.

spirals.speaker: LAEVI
spirals.text: Whoever was it when we ended last time is the anglerfish.
spirals.zh: LAEVI: Whoever was it when we ended last time is the anglerfish.

spirals.speaker: LAEVI
spirals.text: *Rule change*! The anglerfish now has to wear a blindfold. (And do *not* peek!)
spirals.zh: LAEVI: Rule change! The anglerfish now has to wear a blindfold. (And do not peek!)

spirals.speaker: LAEVI
spirals.text: The rest of us (the littlefish) line up against one wall. When the anglerfish says go, the littlefish sneak across to the other side.
spirals.zh: LAEVI: The rest of us (the littlefish) line up against one wall. When the anglerfish says go, the littlefish sneak across to the other side.

spirals.speaker: LAEVI
spirals.text: If the anglerfish catches you, you're eaten.
spirals.zh: LAEVI: If the anglerfish catches you, you’re eaten.

spirals.speaker: LAEVI
spirals.text: Last anglerfish to be caught is the new anglerfish! (The old anglerfish gives the new anglerfish the blindfold and becomes a littlefish.)
spirals.zh: LAEVI: Last littlefish to be caught is the new anglerfish! (The old anglerfish gives the new anglerfish the blindfold and becomes a littlefish.)

spirals.speaker: LAMI
spirals.text: Why are we changing it? It's too hard if you can't see anything!
spirals.zh: LAMI: Why are we changing it? It’s too hard if you can’t see anything!

spirals.speaker: LAEVI
spirals.text: Aunt Pye says real anglerfish are blind, so you have to wear a blindfold! The rule stands!
spirals.zh: LAEVI: Aunt Pye says real anglerfish are blind, so you have to wear a blindfold! The rule stands!

spirals.speaker: ILEX
spirals.text: Rule update: It's okay if younger kids don't wear the blindfold when they're it. (The rest of us will still wear it for scientific accuracy and to make the game more even.)
spirals.zh: ILEX: Rule update: It’s okay if younger kids don’t wear the blindfold when they’re it. (The rest of us will still wear it for scientific accuracy and to make the game more even.)

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: Anglerfish study
spirals.zh: MELORAE: Anglerfish study

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: Visually, this specimen appears to be of the same species as the anglerfish in Dark Bramble. We don't believe it originated from this planet.
spirals.zh: MELORAE: Visually, the specimen appears to be of the same species as the anglerfish in Dark Bramble. We don’t believe it originated from this planet.

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: This anglerfish's digestive tract suggests death by starvation.
spirals.zh: COLEUS: This anglerfish’s digestive tract suggests death by starvation.

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: The long growth protruding from its head is bioluminescent. Perhaps it used this to attract prey (a lure?).
spirals.zh: MELORAE: The long growth protruding from its head is bioluminescent. Perhaps it used this growth to attract prey (a lure?).

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: An update: Melorae, while I was here making sketches of the anglerfish, I observed the children I saw earlier playing here again. They've added a rule to their game that incorporates our research (it's wonderful)!
spirals.zh: COLEUS: An update: Melorae, while I was here making sketches of the anglerfish, I observed the children I saw earlier playing here again. They’ve added a rule to their game that incorporates our research (it’s wonderful)!

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: I'm entirely delighted! It's never too early to appreciate biology!
spirals.zh: MELORAE: I’m entirely delighted! It’s never too early to appreciate biology!

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: I don't know why everyone says the Eye is important.
spirals.zh: SOLANUM: I don’t know why everyone says the Eye is important.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: They say it brought us to this solar system, but is that good? Dad told me lots of Nomai died when our clan came here.
spirals.zh: SOLANUM: They say it brought us to this solar system, but is that good? Dad told me lots of Nomai died when our clan came here.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: What if the Eye wanted that to happen?
spirals.zh: SOLANUM: What if the Eye wanted that to happen?

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: What if the Eye isn't something good?
spirals.zh: SOLANUM: What if the Eye isn’t something good?

spirals.text: Be welcomed in this place. This shrine is a space to reflect on what brought us here to this star system: The signal from the Eye.
spirals.zh: Be welcomed in this place. This shrine is a space to reflect on what brought us to this star system: the signal from the Eye.

spirals.text: We observed the Eye's signal in our travels, and followed it here to find its source.
spirals.zh: We observed the Eye’s signal in our travels, and followed it here to find its source.

spirals.text: What we know is this: The source of the signal (which we have chosen to call the Eye of the universe) is older than the universe itself. The rest, we have yet to learn.
spirals.zh: What we know is this: The source of the signal (which we have chosen to call the Eye of the universe) is older than this universe itself. The rest, we have yet to learn.

spirals.text: Enter, and open your mind to its possibilities.
spirals.zh: Enter, and open your mind to its possibilities.

spirals.text: If the Eye called to us, why won't it reveal itself? Why is it so difficult to locate it?
spirals.zh: If the Eye called to us, why won’t it reveal itself? Why is it so difficult to locate it?

spirals.text: Did something happen to it?
spirals.zh: Did something happen to it?

spirals.text: Did the signal stop? Does the Eye no longer desire to be found?
spirals.zh: Did the signal stop? Does the Eye no longer desire to be found?

spirals.text: Perhaps this isn't the Eye’s choice. The Eye may not be able to communicate with us more than it already has.
spirals.zh: Perhaps this isn’t the Eye’s choice. The Eye may not be able to communicate with us more than it already has.

spirals.text: Is the Eye natural, or artificial?
spirals.zh: Is the Eye natural, or artificial?

spirals.text: Maybe someone built it.
spirals.zh: Maybe someone built it.

spirals.text: The Eye is older than the universe itself. How could something exist before its creator?
spirals.zh: The Eye is older than the universe itself. How could something exist before its creator?

spirals.text: It could be naturally occurring, though this doesn't answer how old the Eye is.
spirals.zh: It could be naturally occurring, though this doesn't answer how the Eye could be as old as it is.

spirals.text: Did the Eye deliberately call out to us by sending the signal, or did we hear the signal by coincidence?
spirals.zh: Did the Eye deliberately call out to us by sending the signal, or did we hear the signal by coincidence?

spirals.text: We could be seeing meaning where there is none. Suppose the signal was produced incidentally.
spirals.zh: We could be seeing meaning where there is none. Suppose the signal was produced incidentally.

spirals.text: Does that mean the Eye is any less important, though?
spirals.zh: Does that mean the Eye is any less important, though?

spirals.text: Perhaps the Eye wanted to be found (could it be sentient?). Maybe it chose us.
spirals.zh: Perhaps the Eye wanted to be found (could it be sentient?). Maybe it chose us.

spirals.text: Does the Eye desire something from  us? Could it need us in some way?
spirals.zh: Does the Eye desire something from us? Could it need us in some way?

spirals.text: Maybe it doesn't have to be us.
spirals.zh: Maybe it doesn’t have to be us.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: Note: This door will need to remain closed for quite some time! Pye and I are running an experiment based on the extraordinary findings from the White Hole Station.
spirals.zh: RAMIE: Note: This door will need to remain closed for some time! Pye and I are running an experiment based on the extraordinary findings from the White Hole Station.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Ramie and I will be running this experiment until one of us (specifically, me) can prove the other wrong, so although it’s inconvenient, the lab currently can only be accessed by the path from the Sunless City.
spirals.zh: PYE: Ramie and I will be running this experiment until one of us (specifically, me) can prove the other wrong, so although it’s inconvenient, the lab currently can only be accessed by the path from the Sunless City.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: Inviting sand inside would disrupt our setup and could have enormous consequences. (We realise this is an intriguing prospect, but the door must remain closed nonetheless!)
spirals.zh: RAMIE: Inviting sand inside would disrupt our setup and could have enormous consequences. (We realize this is an intriguing prospect, but the door must remain closed nonetheless!)

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: An update: The High Energy Lab is now being used to design the Ash Twin Project! If you’re here to help (or even just to observe), be sure to use the Sunless City path to the lab.
spirals.zh: RAMIE: An update: The High Energy Lab is now being used to design the Ash Twin Project! If you’re here to help (or even just to observe), be sure to use the Sunless City path to the lab.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Records show Nomai arriving at the warp receiver on Brittle Hollow very slightly before departing from the White Hole Station. Ramie and I are devising an experiment to test whether this is a real phenomenon or a simple machine error.
spirals.zh: PYE: Records show Nomai arriving at the warp receiver on Brittle Hollow very slightly before departing from the White Hole Station. Ramie and I are devising an experiment to test if this is a real phenomenon or simple machine error.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: In theory, what we want to try to reproduce is a negative amount of time elapsing between something entering the back hole and exiting the white hole at its destination.
spirals.zh: RAMIE: In theory, what we want to try to reproduce is a negative amount of time elapsing between something entering the black hole and exiting the white hole at its destination.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Initial things first: Our experiment setup will first pair a small black hole core with a small white hole core to mimic the setup on the White Hole Station.
spirals.zh: PYE: Initial things first: Our experiment setup will first pair a small black hole core with a small white hole core to mimic the setup on the White Hole Station.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: Hypothesis: It is possible for an object to exit an white hole before entering the corresponding black hole.
spirals.zh: RAMIE: Hypothesis: It is possible for an object to exit a white hole before entering the corresponding black hole.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: An update: Our experiment here reproduced the anomaly in arrival and departure times, but Pye is unconvinced it's more than an equipment error. I hope to strengthen the effect to render it visible to the unaided eyes.
spirals.zh: RAMIE: An update: Our experiment here reproduced the anomaly in arrival and departure times, but Pye is unconvinced it’s more than an equipment error. I hope to strengthen the effect to render it visible to the unaided eyes.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: To that end, we've decided to try adding more energy. I imagine the Sunless city's energy supply should prove sufficient.
spirals.zh: PYE: To that end, we’ve decided to try adding more energy. I imagine the Sunless City’s energy supply should prove sufficient.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Of note, Ramie: Yarrow requests that we let him know before we reroute energy to the experiment.
spirals.zh: PYE: Of note, Ramie: Yarrow requests that we let him know before we reroute energy to the experiment.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: I'd hate to leave him in the dark!
spirals.zh: RAMIE: I’d hate to leave him in the dark!

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: All available energy has been rerouted from the city to our experiment. Ramie and I are about to run a new test.
spirals.zh: PYE: All available energy has been rerouted from the city to our experiment. Ramie and I are about to run a new test.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: Hypothesis confirmed! Hypothesis confirmed! I saw it! Pye saw it! *Hypothesis confirmed*!
spirals.zh: RAMIE: Hypothesis confirmed! Hypothesis confirmed! I saw it! Pye saw it! Hypothesis confirmed!

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: This is beyond extraordinary! This changes *everything*! What a beautiful day for the intersection of abstract theory and practical application!
spirals.zh: PYE: This is beyond extraordinary! This changes everything! What a beautiful day for the intersection of abstract theory and practical application!

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: The Southern Observatory is asking if creating a 22 minute interval is possible (that is, to have something arrive 22 minutes before it is actually sent through the warp).
spirals.zh: RAMIE: The Southern Observatory is asking if creating a 22 minute interval is possible (that is, to have something arrive 22 minutes before it is actually sent through the warp).

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: We've learned the negative interval of time between departure and arrival can be increased by adding more energy to the warp core. Problematically, the energy required to extend the interval increases at an exponential rate.
spirals.zh: RAMIE: We’ve learned the negative interval of time between departure and arrival can be increased by adding more energy to the warp core. Problematically, the energy required to extend the interval increases at an exponential rate.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Hypothesis: Creating a 22-minute-long interval is possible, but we are currently unable to generate the necessary energy.
spirals.zh: PYE: Hypothesis: Creating a 22-minute-long interval is possible, but we are currently unable to generate the necessary energy.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: the energy is *currently* unavailable? You're a gas, Pye!
spirals.zh: RAMIE: The energy is currently unavailable, you say? You’re a gas, Pye!

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: My pun was unintended, Ramie, so I believe it's you who's aeriform!
spirals.zh: PYE: My pun was unintended, Ramie, so I believe it’s you who’s aeriform!

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Ramie and I believe it would be necessary to invent a new method of producing energy, a thrilling but enormous undertaking. We would also require advanced warp technology able to handle such energy.
spirals.zh: PYE: Ramie and I believe it would be necessary to invent a new method of producing energy, a thrilling but enormous undertaking. We would also require advanced warp technology able to handle such energy.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: We also likely need an enormous space to fit these proposed new energy and warp technologies together. The only location large enough would be Ash Twin.
spirals.zh: PYE: We would also likely need an enormous space to fit these proposed new energy and warp technologies together. The only location large enough would be Ash Twin.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: The Ash Twin Project will be one of our biggest undertakings (metaphorically *and* physically). To build it, we need a sound way to travel quickly between Ash Twin and each location that holds crucial project materials.
spirals.zh: 派伊：灰烬双星计划将会是我们最庞大的工程之一（无论在比喻意义上还是物理意义上）。为了建造它，我们需要一种方法，在灰烬双星和每个存放计划所需关键材料的地点之间快速往返。

spirals.speaker: ROOT
spirals.text: What if we used warp towers (like the one we have on the white hole station) to connect each planet directly to Ash Twin?
spirals.zh: 鲁特：如果我们使用跃迁塔（就像白洞站上的那座一样）把灰烬双星直接连接到每个关键地点呢？

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Poke, Root and I can begin work on this immediately in the Black Hole Forge (this will keep us busy!).
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：珀克、鲁特和我可以立刻在黑洞熔炉展开这项工作（这会让我们忙起来的！）。

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Of note: Each tower on Ash Twin will warp to a different planet.
spirals.zh: 亚罗：注意：灰烬双星上的每座塔都会跃迁到不同的行星。

spirals.speaker: PHLOX
spirals.text: we can design each warp tower to visually reflect its warp destination!
spirals.zh: 弗拉克斯：我们可以把每座塔的外观都设计成对应跃迁目的地的风格！

spirals.speaker: PHLOX
spirals.text: The Giant’s Deep tower, for instance, could resemble a cyclone. And we could add trees to the Timber Hearth tower!
spirals.zh: 弗拉克斯：比如，深巨星塔可以像一团气旋。而木炉星塔可以模仿间歇泉山来设计！

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: This planet sometimes (and only sometimes) has a moon! This is also of note: It disappears if no one is watching it! Isn't that a *fascinating* orbital characteristic!
spirals.zh: MELORAE: This planet sometimes (and only sometimes) has a moon! This is also of note: It disappears if no one is watching it! Isn’t that a fascinating orbital characteristic?

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: This is my first time encountering a natural satellite with the ability to vanish when not being watched. We should study it! Or, even better, we should travel there!
spirals.zh: MELORAE: This is my first time encountering a natural satellite with the ability to vanish when not being watched. We should study it! Or, even better, we should travel there!

spirals.speaker: BUR
spirals.text: I agree! Our first step would be determining a method to track this phantom moon so that we can always know where it is.
spirals.zh: BUR: I agree! Our first step would be determining a method to track this phantom moon so that we can always know where it is.

spirals.speaker: ANNONA
spirals.text: Given its reluctance to move while consciously observed, it might be a former of macroscopic quantum mechanics.
spirals.zh: ANNONA: Given its reluctance to move while consciously observed, it might be a form of macroscopic quantum mechanics.

spirals.speaker: BUR
spirals.text: I found your note, Melorae; kindly count me among this moon's admirers! What is happening when it disappears (I doubt it ceases to exist)? Does it move to another location?
spirals.zh: BUR: I found your note, Melorae; kindly count me among this moon’s admirers! What is happening when it disappears (I doubt it ceases to exist)? Does it move to another location?

spirals.speaker: ANNONA
spirals.text: I believe so. Not only does the moon appear around Brittle Hollow, I can confirm it sometimes orbits Timber Hearth, as well.
spirals.zh: ANNONA: I believe so. Not only does the moon appear around Brittle Hollow, I can confirm it sometimes orbits Timber Hearth, as well.

spirals.speaker: ANNONA
spirals.text: The Quantum Moon locator is functioning. We have markers for each of the places the moon goes.
spirals.zh: 安诺纳：量子卫星定位器运转正常。卫星会前往的每个地点，我们都有对应的标记。

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: Annona, Bur, I just observed the Quantum Moon in orbit around Dark Bramble.
spirals.zh: 梅洛瑞：安诺纳，伯尔，我刚刚观察到量子卫星出现在黑棘星的轨道上。

spirals.speaker: ANNONA
spirals.text: You have keen eyes, my friend. So this moon travels to a total of five planets, not four.
spirals.zh: 安诺纳：你的眼神可真好，我的朋友。这么说，这颗卫星一共会前往五个地点，而不是四个。

spirals.speaker: BUR
spirals.text: I added a marker for Dark Bramble.
spirals.zh: 伯尔：我添加了黑棘星的标记。

spirals.speaker: BUR
spirals.text: I thought the locator now accounted for all of the phantom moon's locations, but sometimes the locator can't tell where the moon is. Perhaps there's a problem with the device?
spirals.zh: 伯尔：我本以为定位器现在已经掌握了幻影卫星的所有位置，但有时定位器还是无法判断卫星在哪里。也许是设备出了问题？

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: It's also possible there exists also sixth place in this star system to which the phantom moon travels.
spirals.zh: 梅洛瑞：也有可能这个星系中还存在第六个地点，幻影卫星会前往那里。

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: This rock is very familiar! Did you travel here, my sedimentary friend? Because your unique colour and texture appears identical to a rock I met earlier.
spirals.zh: MELORAE: This rock is very familiar! Did you travel here, my sedimentary friend? Because your unique color and texture appears identical to a rock I met earlier.

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: wasn't this the same rock fragment in the cave we found at the bottom of the dry lakebed (at the north pole)?
spirals.zh: MELORAE: Wasn’t this same rock fragment in the cave we found at the bottom of the dry lakebed (at the north pole)?

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: We plan to reexamine the Northern Lakebed Cave. (Maybe our friendly rock will meet us down there!
spirals.zh: COLEUS: We plan to reexamine the northern Lakebed Cave. (Maybe our friendly rock will meet us down there!)

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: An update: Melorae and I went back to the lakebed cave and observed this rock again. Sometimes it's there, and sometimes it isn't.
spirals.zh: COLEUS: An update: Melorae and I went back to the Lakebed Cave and observed this rock again. Sometimes it’s there, and sometimes it isn’t.

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: That means this rock wanders like the Quantum Moon does. How curious!
spirals.zh: MELORAE: That means this rock wanders like the Quantum Moon does. How curious!

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: Coleus is missing! He vanished from the Lakebed Cave (The one at the bottom of the dry lakebed at the north pole) several days ago, and we’re unable to find any trace of him. I don’t know how much air he had when he disappeared. I beg any friend reading this, help us recover Coleus!
spirals.zh: MELORAE: Coleus is missing! He vanished from the Lakebed Cave (the one at the bottom of the dry lakebed at the north pole) several days ago, and we’re unable to find any trace of him. I don’t know how much air he had when he disappeared. I beg any friend reading this, help us recover Coleus!

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: Friends, if you find any sign of Coleus, I implore you to tell me! He vanished without a trace during our research trip, and he has been missing ever since.
spirals.zh: MELORAE: Friends, if you find any sign of Coleus, I implore you to tell me! He vanished without a trace during our research trip, and has been missing ever since.

spirals.speaker: BUR
spirals.text: Melorae, some of us from the sunless city are here to help search for Coleus. Can you tell us more about your expedition?
spirals.zh: BUR: Melorae, some of us from the Sunless City are here to help search for Coleus. Can you tell us more about your expedition?

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: You have my gratitude, Bur! Coleus and I were studying the cave’s geology. We hoped to learn more about a unique and wandering rock that visits several different caves in the area.
spirals.zh: MELORAE: You have my gratitude, Bur! Coleus and I were studying the caves’ geology. We hoped to learn more about a unique and wandering rock that visits several different caves in the area.

spirals.speaker: ANNONA
spirals.text: Where was Coleus lost, Melorae?
spirals.zh: ANNONA: Where was young Coleus lost, Melorae?

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: He disappeared in the cave at the bottom of the dry lakebed at the north pole. It happened in an instant, without warning.
spirals.zh: MELORAE: He disappeared in the cave at the bottom of the dry lakebed at the north pole. It happened in an instant, and without warning.

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: I turned away from Coleus to examine a sample, and when I turned back, he simply wasn't there anymore. He had any limited supply of air, Annona! I'm afraid for him!
spirals.zh: MELORAE: I turned away from Coleus to examine a sample, and when I turned back, he simply wasn’t there anymore. He had a limited supply of air, Annona! I’m afraid for him!

spirals.speaker: ANNONA
spirals.text: Hypothesis: We will learn more by examining the Northern Lakebed Cave where Coleus disappeared. Search quickly, everyone; we have no time to squander!
spirals.zh: ANNONA: Hypothesis: We will learn more by examining the northern Lakebed Cave where Coleus disappeared. Search quickly, everyone; we have no time to squander!

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: If you've come to look for Coleus, this is where we were when he vanished. He's been missing for two days now!
spirals.zh: 梅洛瑞：如果你们是来这里寻找科利耶斯的，他就是在这里消失的。他已经失踪两天了！

spirals.speaker: ANNONA
spirals.text: Your strange, wandering rock friend is here, though Coleus isn't.
spirals.zh: 安诺纳：你那个古怪的、四处游荡的岩石朋友倒还在这里，科利耶斯却不见了。

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: Coleus and I observed this unusual-looking rock shard (and several smaller rocks) in at least two other caverns. I'm unsure if this is relevant.
spirals.zh: 梅洛瑞：科利耶斯和我在至少另外两个洞窟里，都观察到了这种模样不同寻常的岩石碎片（还有一些较小的岩石）。我不知道这一切是否有所关联。

spirals.speaker: BUR
spirals.text: What happened before Coleus disappeared?
spirals.zh: 伯尔：科利耶斯消失之前发生了什么？

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: We were examining the different rocks. I recall Coleus standing on the latest one (the wandering rock). I was taking notes, and then my lantern died.
spirals.zh: 梅洛瑞：我们当时正在检查那些异样的岩石。我记得科利耶斯站在最大的一块上（那块流浪岩石）。我正在做笔记，然后我的灯灭了。

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: When I lit it again, Coleus and the rock were gone.
spirals.zh: 梅洛瑞：等我重新点亮灯时，科利耶斯和那块岩石都不见了。

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: How curious! This rock took me with it to a new location. I wonder why this happened?
spirals.zh: COLEUS: How curious! This rock took me with it to a new location. I wonder why this happened?

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: curious, but also alarming: This new cave appears to lack an entrance or exit. Also, the rock that brought me here disappeared while I wasn't watching.
spirals.zh: COLEUS: Curious, but also alarming: This new cave appears to lack an entrance or exit. Also, the rock that brought me here disappeared while I wasn’t watching.

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: the wandering rock had returned! Never before have I been so delighted to see a sedimentary specimen.
spirals.zh: COLEUS: The wandering rock has returned! Never before have I been so delighted to see a sedimentary specimen.

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: I wonder if I myself became quantum briefly when the rock carried me here! This seems the clearest explanation. Hypothesis: If the rock can bring me here, it can also carry me out.
spirals.zh: COLEUS: I wonder if I myself became quantum briefly when the rock carried me here! This seems the clearest explanation. Hypothesis: If the rock can bring me here, it can also carry me out.

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: My hypothesis was correct! I can travel on this rock, as long as I'm not observing my surroundings (meaning I must enter in complete darkness). I'm going to bring my mentor here to see this.
spirals.zh: COLEUS: My hypothesis was correct! I can travel on this rock, as long as I’m not observing my surroundings (meaning I must be in complete darkness). I’m going to bring my mentor here to see this.

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: Melorae is here now, too. We theorize when a conscious being is in contact with a quantum object and ceases to act as an observer (explaining the need for darkness), the being can become entangled with that quantum object, and they move together.
spirals.zh: COLEUS: Melorae is here now, too. We theorize when a conscious being is in contact with a quantum object and ceases to act as an observer (explaining the need for darkness), the being can become entangled with that quantum object, and they move together.

spirals.speaker: MELORAE
spirals.text: Friends, Coleus has discovered a new quantum rule! (He has also promised me he'll never vanish again, even if he *does* learn something useful from it!)
spirals.zh: MELORAE: Friends, Coleus has discovered a new quantum rule! (He has also promised me he’ll never vanish again, even if he does learn something useful from it!)

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Some time has passed since I checked in with you, Pye. How are you and Idaea progressing with the Sun Station plans?
spirals.zh: 亚罗：派伊，距离我上次找你了解情况已经过去一段时间了。你和伊代亚在太阳站计划上进展如何？

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Presently, my assessment is that our plan will either fail explosively or succeed explosively.
spirals.zh: 派伊：目前，我的评估是我们的计划要么会爆炸性地失败，要么会爆炸性地成功。

spirals.speaker: IDAEA
spirals.text: Pye, you know I don't find that funny.
spirals.zh: 伊代亚：派伊，你知道我并不觉得好笑。

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: How curious; Ramie thinks I'm a gas. And I don't recall requesting that you monitor this conversation, Idaea.
spirals.zh: PYE: How curious; Ramie thinks I’m a gas. And I don’t recall requesting that you monitor this conversation, Idaea.

spirals.speaker: IDAEA
spirals.text: I don't see what state of matter you are has to do with this. And I don't recall supporting the Sun Station’s construction, but here we are.
spirals.zh: IDAEA: I don’t see what state of matter you are has to do with this. And I don’t recall supporting the Sun Station’s construction, but here we are.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Hypothesis: Time spent away from the station would be beneficial to you both.
spirals.zh: YARROW: Hypothesis: Time spent away from the station would be beneficial to you both.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: I'm immensely interested in testing your hypothesis, Yarrow.
spirals.zh: PYE: I’m immensely interested in testing your hypothesis, Yarrow.

spirals.speaker: IDAEA
spirals.text: That, at least, we can agree on.
spirals.zh: IDAEA: That, at least, we can agree on.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Friends visiting from the Hanging City, we are planning the Ash Twin Project at the High Energy Lab on Ember Twin’s equator.
spirals.zh: PYE: Friends visiting from the Hanging City, we are planning the Ash Twin Project at the High Energy Lab on Ember Twin’s equator.

spirals.speaker: CONOY
spirals.text: I became lost on Ember Twin (my gratitude that Ramie found me!), but the High Energy Lab is the building with the large solar panels. I’m surprised I didn’t see it!
spirals.zh: CONOY: I became lost on Ember Twin (my gratitude that Ramie found me!), but the High Energy Lab is the building with the large solar panels. I’m suprised I didn’t see it!

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: I imagine our otherwise immensely clever friend Conoy would lose his own head if it weren’t anatomically impossible!
spirals.zh: RAMIE: I imagine our otherwise immensely clever Conoy would lose his own head if it weren’t anatomically impossible!

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Here's our first delivery, Yarrow: One warp core, fresh from the Black Hole Forge! Root is installing this core’s sibling on Brittle Hollow as I write this
spirals.zh: CLARY: Here’s our first delivery, Yarrow: one warp core, fresh from the Black Hole Forge! Root is installing this core’s sibling on Brittle Hollow as I write this.

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: I wish I could wait here for you to arrive, but the forge (and my unfinished work there) is calling. I'll return with more materials soon.
spirals.zh: CLARY: I wish I could wait here for you to arrive, but the forge (and my unfinished work there) is calling. I’ll return with more materials soon.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: My gratitude, Clary! With his, the Ash Twin Project is well underway!
spirals.zh: YARROW: My gratitude, Clary! With this, the Ash Twin Project is underway!

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: I confess, I'm deeply curious about what you and Poke found on the White Hole Station that started this project. Could I visit sometime to learn more?
spirals.zh: YARROW: I confess, I’m deeply curious about what you and Poke found on the White Hole Station that started this project. Could I visit sometime to learn more?

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: I recommend you do! The White Hole Station is the model for the towers being built for the Ash Twin Project, so a visit to the station would be doubly useful.
spirals.zh: CLARY: I recommend you do! The White Hole Station is the model for the towers being built for the Ash Twin Project, so a visit to the station would be doubly useful.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: I suppose, more precisely, I would like to visit the station with *you*, Clary
spirals.zh: YARROW: I suppose, more precisely, I would like to visit the White Hole Station with you, Clary.

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: I'd be happy to explain our findings!
spirals.zh: CLARY: I’d be happy to explain our findings!

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Yarrow, stop using this scroll wall to flirt with my sister (in romantic matters, her density rivals a neutron star's) and go and meet her on the White Hole Station.
spirals.zh: POKE: Yarrow, stop using this scroll wall to flirt with my sister (in romantic matters, her density rivals a neutron star’s) and go meet her on the White Hole Station.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Today we finished the excavation of the Ash Twin. Here, in this space we carved, we will craft our most ambitious project yet: The Ash Twin Project, powerful enough to send information back in time.
spirals.zh: YARROW: Today we finished the excavation of Ash Twin. Here, in this space we carved, we will craft our most ambitious project yet: the Ash Twin Project, powerful enough to send information back in time.

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: We’ve also finished relocating all subtareenean plants we met while digging.
spirals.zh: COLEUS: We’ve also finished relocating all subterranean plants we met while digging.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: We’ll need to keep an eye on how significantly we’ve altered the environment here.
spirals.zh: RAMIE: We’ll need to keep our eyes on how significantly we’ve altered the environment here.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: How far we’ve come since our experiments at the High Energy Lab! I still can hardly believe Ramie’s hypothesis was true.
spirals.zh: PYE: How far we’ve come since our experiments at the High Energy Lab! I still can hardly believe Ramie’s hypothesis was true.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Poke just sent us the warp core for the final warp tower to us from the Black Hole Forge. Now Ash Twin can be connected with Giant’s Deep, where Cassava is working with Avens to craft the Orbital Probe Cannon, and where Phlox is crafting the memory statues.
spirals.zh: YARROW: Poke just sent the warp core for the final tower to us from the Black Hole Forge. Now Ash Twin can be connected with Giant’s Deep, where Cassava is working with Avens to craft the Orbital Probe Cannon, and where Phlox is sculpting the memory statues.

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: Hypothesis: it was not by accident the core of our warp tower was the last to be forged.
spirals.zh: CASSAVA: Hypothesis: It was not by accident the core of our warp tower was the last to be forged.

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Hypothesis: The cores could have been forged much faster if Cassava had interrupted my work less frequently to ask for updates.
spirals.zh: POKE: Hypothesis: The cores could have been forged faster if Cassava had interrupted my work less frequently to ask for updates.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: The important point is we are all connected through the Ash Twin now, and also that I’m no longer needed for mediating your disagreements.
spirals.zh: YARROW: The important point is we are all connected through Ash Twin now, and also that I’m no longer needed for mediating your disagreements.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Our friends on Giant’s Deep tested the Orbital Probe Cannon today. Mallow tells me the cannon is doing well, and that Avens advocates for more launch power. If anyone can coax the maximum power from a device, Avens can.
spirals.zh: YARROW: Our friends on Giant’s Deep tested the Orbital Probe Cannon today. Mallow tells me the cannon is doing well, and that Avens advocates for more launch power. If anyone can coax the maximum power from a device, Avens can.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: But then, if anyone can goad a device into exploding, that, too, is likely Avens. Perhaps I should check in with the Orbital Probe Cannon crew in the interest of safety.
spirals.zh: YARROW: But then, if anyone can goad a device into exploding, that, too, is likely Avens. Perhaps I should check in with the Orbital Probe Cannon crew in the interest of safety.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Would it help to remind Avens that Mallow (his love) will be one of the Nomai aboard the cannon, or is Mallow part of the problem?
spirals.zh: YARROW: Would it help to remind Avens that Mallow (his love) will be one of the Nomai aboard the cannon, or is Mallow part of the problem?

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Phlox and Daz finished the memory statues today, and they are truly remarkable.
spirals.zh: YARROW: Phlox and Daz finished the memory statues today, and they are truly remarkable.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: When the Ash Twin Project succeeds (or in the event it fails), the memory statues will activate, allowing us to gather more data before we shut down the project.
spirals.zh: YARROW: When the Ash Twin Project succeeds (or in the event it fails), the memory statues will activate, allowing us to gather more data before we shut down the project.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Pye and Idaea have worked hard on the Sun Station, and it at last is complete. If everything goes as planned, this structure will prompt the sun’s explosion, which will in turn supply the power the Ash Twin Project requires.
spirals.zh: YARROW: Pye and Idaea have worked hard on the Sun Station, and it at last is complete. If everything goes as planned, this structure will prompt the sun’s explosion, which will in turn supply the power the Ash Twin Project requires.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: I’m impressed by their mental fortitude. This was the project’s most difficult task, in more ways than one.
spirals.zh: RAMIE: I’m impressed by their mental fortitude. This was the project’s most difficult task, in more ways than one.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: We’re nearly ready to activate the Ash Twin Project! Here is what will happen: First, the Sun Station will receive an order to fire at the sun, prompting it to explode.
spirals.zh: YARROW: We’re nearly ready to activate the Ash Twin Project! Here is what will happen: First, the Sun Station will receive the order to fire at the sun, prompting it to explode.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Using the energy from the resulting supernova, the Ash Twin Project will send the order for the Orbital Probe Cannon to fire back in time by 22 minutes.
spirals.zh: YARROW: Using the energy from the resulting supernova, the Ash Twin Project will send the order for the Orbital Probe Cannon to fire back in time by 22 minutes.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Exactly 22 minutes after these orders are received, the Sun Station will again trigger the supernova to send the probe data from this cannon launch back in time.
spirals.zh: YARROW: Exactly 22 minutes after these orders are received, the Sun Station will again trigger the supernova to send the probe data from this cannon launch back in time.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: In total, each cycle created by the Ash Twin Project will last precisely 22 minutes. We can end this cycle at will.
spirals.zh: YARROW: In total, each cycle created by the Ash Twin Project will last precisely 22 minutes. We can end this cycle at will.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: These words are difficult to write: The Sun Station did not work.
spirals.zh: YARROW: These words are difficult to write: The Sun Station did not work.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: However, this is the closest we have ever been. The Ash Twin Project is theoretically sound; we were only unable to power it. Perhaps there is another way.
spirals.zh: YARROW: However, this is the closest we have ever been. The Ash Twin Project is theoretically sound; we were only unable to power it. Perhaps there is another way.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Suppose we redesign the Sun Station. To generate a power of that magnitude, a supernova is still our only viable option.
spirals.zh: PYE: Suppose we redesign the Sun Station. To generate power of that magnitude, a supernova is still our only viable option.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: I believe we can still find a way to create a supernova, my friend. Don’t lose hope!
spirals.zh: RAMIE: I believe we can still find a way to create a supernova, my friend. Don’t lose hope!

spirals.speaker: IDAEA
spirals.text: This is easier expressed than accomplished.
spirals.zh: IDAEA: This is easier expressed than accomplished.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: You can wait for the sun to explode on its natural timeline if you prefer, Idaea, but you’ll need to find some way to halt our aging process.
spirals.zh: PYE: You can wait for the sun to explode on its natural timeline if you prefer, Idaea, but you’ll need to find some way to halt our aging process.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: We are halting our research into creating a supernova for this moment; a comet has newly arrived in this solar system, and we’re anxious to explore it.
spirals.zh: YARROW: We are halting our research into creating a supernova for this moment; a comet has newly arrived in this solar system, and we’re anxious to explore it.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: It’s been a very long time since we last explored somewhere new, so we’re excited to welcome this comet. Imagine what knowledge might be gained there!
spirals.zh: YARROW: It’s been a very long time since we last explored somewhere new, so we’re excited to welcome this comet. Imagine what knowledge might be gained there!

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: My gratitude for the latest shipment, Oeno! This ore should be the last we'll need for the Ash Twin Project.
spirals.zh: 亚罗：多谢你送来的最后一批矿石，奥埃诺！这些矿石应该就是灰烬双星计划所需的最后一批了。

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Once we've finished the shell that seals off the core, we'll check to ensure there are no longer any physical entrances. Ramie and I will be checking the interior for cracks (our final safety check)
spirals.zh: 亚罗：等我们完成封闭中央舱室的外壳后，就会检查确认上面没有任何能与内部物理接触的方式。瑞米和我会先检查内部，再检查外部是否存在裂缝（这是我们的最终安全检查）。

spirals.speaker: OENO
spirals.text: This is exciting news! Can I offer an extra set of eyes for this final check (specifically, mine)? If my work here is complete, I'd be delighted to help.
spirals.zh: 奥埃诺：这消息真是激动人心！最终检查还需要额外的眼睛帮忙吗（特别是我的）？如果我这里的工作做完了，我会十分乐意帮忙。

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: We'd be grateful if you would! The more eyes, the better, as the smallest flaw or opening in the shell that protects the core could lead to disaster.
spirals.zh: 亚罗：如果你愿意，我们会非常感谢！来检查的眼睛越多越好，因为保护外壳上哪怕只有一个细微的瑕疵或开口，也会对灰烬双星计划造成灾难性的后果。

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: I have good news, Yarrow! The advanced warp core is ready to be installed at the heart of the Ash Twin Project.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：我有好消息，亚罗！高级跃迁核心已经准备好安装到灰烬双星的中央舱室里了。

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: I'm intrigued, love!

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: No, it isn't!
spirals.zh: 珀克：不，还没好！

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Is everything well at the forge?
spirals.zh: 亚罗：熔炉那边一切都好吗？

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Don't worry, love; Poke is only nervous. The core is extraordinary, and her design work is beautifully clever.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：别担心，亲爱的；珀克只是紧张。这个核心非同凡响，她的设计工作也漂亮又巧妙。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: The core’s durability could still be improved! I need more time!
spirals.zh: 珀克：核心的耐久性还有提升空间！我需要更多时间！

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Ignore her, Yarrow. The core is finished. And if my sister tells you otherwise, then *she* will be finished, as well.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：别理她，亚罗。核心已经完成了。如果我的姐妹告诉你不是这样，那她也要完了。

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: I've installed the masks inside the Ash Twin Project, Phlox. They look beautiful (although I do feel as though I'm being observed!).
spirals.zh: RAMIE: I’ve installed the masks inside the Ash Twin Project, Phlox. They look beautiful (although I do feel as though I’m being observed!).

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: It's comforting to know the statues will not pair until the project succeeds. Otherwise, I imagine the experience would be hard to endure!
spirals.zh: RAMIE: It’s comforting to know the statues will not pair until the project succeeds. Otherwise, I imagine the experience would be hard to endure!

spirals.speaker: PHLOX
spirals.text: Ideally, they'll only need to activate once the project succeeds; as a safety measure, however, the states will also activate in the event of equipment failure.
spirals.zh: PHLOX: Ideally, they’ll only need to activate once the project succeeds; as a safety measure, however, the statues will also activate in the event of equipment failure.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: They will? Why is that?
spirals.zh: RAMIE: They will? Why is that?

spirals.speaker: PHLOX
spirals.text: If anything goes wrong with the Ash Twin Project, the statues (and their masks) will make us aware of the situation and enable us to fix it. Otherwise, it would be possible for us to remain permanently unaware of the problem.
spirals.zh: PHLOX: If anything goes wrong with the Ash Twin Project, the statues (and their masks) will make us aware of the situation and enable us to fix it. Otherwise, it would be possible for us to remain permanently unaware of the problem.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: I hadn't thought of that! What a profoundly horrific thought that would be.
spirals.zh: RAMIE: I hadn’t thought of that! What a profoundly horrific fate that would be.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: I have exciting news, Privet: the Ash Twin Project is almost prepared to receive the probe data from the Orbital Probe Cannon.
spirals.zh: YARROW: I have exciting news, Privet: The Ash Twin Project is almost prepared to receive the probe data from the Orbital Probe Cannon.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Ramie is adding some finishing touches here, but she'll be finished soon. Are you and the Orbital Probe Cannon well?
spirals.zh: YARROW: Ramie is adding some finishing touches here, but she’ll be finished soon. Are you and the Orbital Probe Cannon well?

spirals.speaker: PRIVET
spirals.text: We are! The Probe Tracking Module is ready to record each launch's flight trajectory and will automatically transmit all relevant data to you.
spirals.zh: PRIVET: We are! The statue here in the Probe Tracking Module is ready to record each launch’s flight trajectory and will automatically transmit all relevant data to you.

spirals.speaker: PRIVET
spirals.text: On the other appendage, I'm now worried about this cannon's structural integrity and its crew's moral integrity.
spirals.zh: PRIVET: On the other appendage, I’m now worried about this cannon’s structural integrity and its crew’s moral integrity.

spirals.speaker: PRIVET
spirals.text: Once the probe determines the location of the Eye of the universe, I'll send an alert directly to you and Ramie.
spirals.zh: PRIVET: Once the probe determines the location of the Eye of the universe, I’ll send an alert directly to you and Ramie.

spirals.speaker: OENO
spirals.text: I'm still amazed by how much ore the Ash Twin Project relies!
spirals.zh: 奥埃诺：灰烬双星计划需要这么多矿石，至今仍让我惊讶！

spirals.speaker: CYCAD
spirals.text: Isn't this the ore for the remaining towers being built on Ash Twin? The completed towers I've seen are quite large!
spirals.zh: 赛卡德：这些不是要用来建造灰烬双星上剩余那些塔的矿石吗？我见过已经完工的塔，它们都相当大！

spirals.speaker: OENO
spirals.text: No, the material for those towers is all being taken from Ash Twin. The ore we're mining here will be used to craft an immensely thick protective shell that will physically seal off the Ash twin's core.
spirals.zh: 奥埃诺：不，那些塔的材料全都取自灰烬双星。我们在这里开采的矿石会被用来打造一层极厚的保护外壳，将灰烬双星核心内部的舱室物理封闭起来。

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: I'm relieved by our clan's decision to use Timber Hearth's ore only for constructing the shell. If, eventually, life on this planet were to evolve to the point of advanced metallurgy, I'm confident we won't have destroyed their ability to create!
spirals.zh: 科利耶斯：我们氏族决定只将木炉星的矿石用于建造外壳，这让我松了一口气。如果有朝一日，这颗行星上的生命演化出了先进的冶金技术，我相信我们也没有阻碍它们创造的能力！

spirals.speaker: CYCAD
spirals.text: If they're sealing off all entrances, I hope they've planned a-*core-*dingly!
spirals.zh: 赛卡德：如果他们要封住所有入口，那我希望他们已经做好了核心计划！

spirals.speaker: OENO
spirals.text: I thought you had forbidden your apprentice from making puns, Coleus.
spirals.zh: 奥埃诺：科利耶斯，我还以为你已经禁止自己的学徒说双关笑话了。

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: How else would he improve?
spirals.zh: 科利耶斯：不然他要怎么进步呢？

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: My gratitude for the latest shipment, Oeno! This ore should be the last we'll need for the Ash Twin Project.
spirals.zh: 亚罗：多谢你送来的最后一批矿石，奥埃诺！这些矿石应该就是灰烬双星计划所需的最后一批了。

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Once we've finished the shell that seals off the core, we'll check to ensure there are no longer any physical entrances. Ramie and I will be checking the interior for cracks (our final safety check)
spirals.zh: 亚罗：等我们完成封闭中央舱室的外壳后，就会检查确认上面没有任何能与内部物理接触的方式。瑞米和我会先检查内部，再检查外部是否存在裂缝（这是我们的最终安全检查）。

spirals.speaker: OENO
spirals.text: This is exciting news! Can I offer an extra set of eyes for this final check (specifically, mine)? If my work here is complete, I'd be delighted to help.
spirals.zh: 奥埃诺：这消息真是激动人心！最终检查还需要额外的眼睛帮忙吗（特别是我的）？如果我这里的工作做完了，我会十分乐意帮忙。

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: We'd be grateful if you would! The more eyes, the better, as the smallest flaw or opening in the shell that protects the core could lead to disaster.
spirals.zh: 亚罗：如果你愿意，我们会非常感谢！来检查的眼睛越多越好，因为保护外壳上哪怕只有一个细微的瑕疵或开口，也会对灰烬双星计划造成灾难性的后果。

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: After closer observation, mining site 2a wouldn't be safe for the native life dwelling in some cave pools, so (unfortunately) we'll have to mine one of the other sites.
spirals.zh: COLEUS: After closer observation, mining site 2a wouldn’t be safe for the native life dwelling in some of this cave’s pools, so (unfortunately) we’ll have to mine one of the other sites.

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: On the opposite hand, new life! This species is semi-aquatic, and very hardy. The ecosystem here is quite robust, so I believe they'll thrive in the long run. Be cautious near the pools if you visit 2a to meet them.
spirals.zh: COLEUS: On the opposite hand, new life! This species is semi-aquatic, and very hardy. The ecosystem here is quite robust, so I believe they’ll thrive in the long run. Be cautious near the pools if you visit 2a to meet them.

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: They remind me of a subterranean species that my mentor, Melorae, once told me about (from when our clan used to travel across this universe). I am sure she would have enjoyed these lifeforms greatly.
spirals.zh: COLEUS: They remind me of a subterranean species that my mentor, Melorae, once told me about (from when our clan used to travel across this universe). I imagine she would have enjoyed these lifeforms greatly.

spirals.speaker: CYCAD
spirals.text: I was watching them once during a rest, and the hours escaped from me. They're fascinating (in wonder what their fourth eye does)!
spirals.zh: CYCAD: I was watching them once during a rest, and the hours escaped from me. They’re fascinating (I wonder what their fourth eye does)!

spirals.speaker: CYCAD
spirals.text: There are a few other sites that look promising. What about site 2b (it shares similar formations and databases)?
spirals.zh: CYCAD: There are a few other cave sites that look promising. What about site 2b (it shares similar formations and strata)?

spirals.speaker: OENO
spirals.text: This sounds promising! Will you and your mentor investigate? If mining site 2b proves safe for this native species, we'll move our work there.
spirals.zh: OENO: This sounds promising! Will you and your mentor investigate? If mining site 2b proves safe for this native species, we’ll move our work there.

spirals.speaker: CYCAD
spirals.text: Site 2b is safe! Coleus says we’ll continue to monitor our activity and its effect on life here.
spirals.zh: CYCAD: Site 2b is safe! Coleus says we’ll continue to monitor our activity and its effect on life here.

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: I was upstairs testing the Eye signal locator, and it can hear and follow the signals from the sun, Giant's Deep, and Brittle Hollow.
spirals.zh: 科利耶斯：我之前在楼上测试眼信号定位器，它能听见并追踪来自太阳、深巨星和碎空星的信号。

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: However, something strange is happening when I ask the Eye signal locator to follow the Eye's signal: The device's indicator rotates wildly and never points to just one direction.
spirals.zh: 科利耶斯：可是，当我让眼信号定位器追踪眼的信号时，发生了奇怪的事：装置的指示器会疯狂旋转，始终无法指向唯一的方向。

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: This is a curious result. It's possible the eye has stopped calling out its signal.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：这是个奇特的结果。也许眼已经停止呼唤了。

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: I see! I most likely calibrated the locator incorrectly. Privet (my apprentice) and I will make adjustments and try again.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：我明白了！很可能是我没有正确校准定位器。普利维特（我的学徒）和我会进行调整，然后再次尝试。

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: An update: Disappointingly, everything is correctly calibrated after all.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：更新：令人失望的是，一切其实都已经正确校准了。

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: It saddens me to posit this, my friends, but I believe we need to build a more sophisticated device if we want to find the exact location of the Eye of the universe.

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Then we will build it. Don't lose hope, Cassava; our search for the Eye is what brought our clan to this place. We won't give up so easily!
spirals.zh: 萨奇：那我们就造。不要失去希望，卡萨瓦；寻找眼是我们的族群来到这里的原因。我们不会这么轻易放弃！

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Where should this new, more sophisticated locator be built? It may need to be larger than this Eye signal locator is.
spirals.zh: THATCH: Where should this new, more sophisticated locator be built? It may need to be larger than this Eye signal locator is.

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: Annona and those of us originally stranded on the Ember Twin built a Quantum Moon locator there, but the heat of the sun made its construction challenging. I wouldn't recommend building on that planet.
spirals.zh: COLEUS: Annona and those of us originally stranded on Ember Twin built a Quantum Moon locator there, but the heat of the sun made its construction challenging. I wouldn’t recommend building on that planet.

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: The southern glacier on Brittle Hollow has ample available space. I could construct a new building to house this proposed locator.
spirals.zh: PLUME: The southern glacier on Brittle Hollow has ample available space. I could construct a new building to house this proposed locator.

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: Yes, let's build there! I imagine our young friend Conoy would enjoy that immensely. He's always had a great interest in the Eye, especially for a child born so long after the crash.
spirals.zh: FILIX: Yes, let’s build there! I imagine our young friend Conoy would enjoy that immensely. He’s always held a great interest in the Eye, especially for a child born so long after the crash.

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: I will begin construction on Brittle Hollow’s south pole immediately, then!
spirals.zh: PLUME: I will begin construction on Brittle Hollow’s south pole immediately, then!

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Is everyone unharmed?
spirals.zh: THATCH: Is everyone unharmed?

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: No one was badly injured from the escape pod's impact. We're incredibly fortunate.
spirals.zh: PLUME: No one was badly injured from the escape pod’s impact. We’re incredibly fortunate.

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: This is good news, at least. Have we heard from escape pod 2 or escape pod 3?
spirals.zh: THATCH: This is good news, at least. Have we heard from Escape Pod 2 or Escape Pod 3?

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: No, I… I'm unable to make contact. My equipment can hear the other two escape pod's signals, though. If it's any comfort, both pods must be structurally intact.
spirals.zh: FILIX: No, I... I’m unable to make contact. My equipment can hear the other two escape pods’ distress signals, however. If it’s any comfort, both pods must be structurally intact.

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: I'll continue calling for them.
spirals.zh: FILIX: I’ll continue calling for them.

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: My gratitude. If we can -
spirals.zh: THATCH: My gratitude. If we can —

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: Thatch, the moon is approaching again!
spirals.zh: PLUME: Thatch, the moon is approaching again!

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Everyone brace yourselves, swiftly! The volcanic moon has returned!
spirals.zh: THATCH: Everyone brace yourselves, swiftly! The volcanic moon has returned!

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Be cautious of falling ash and debris!
spirals.zh: THATCH: Be cautious of falling ash and debris!

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: … I believe the moon has passed.
spirals.zh: PLUME: ...I believe the moon has passed.

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: This planet doesn't appear eager to have guests. We are certainly unwelcome on this planet.
spirals.zh: FILIX: This planet doesn’t appear eager to have guests. We are certainly unwelcome on its surface.

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: We need to find shelter, and quickly. The volcanic moon won't be gone for long.
spirals.zh: THATCH: We need to find shelter, and quickly. The volcanic moon won’t be gone for long.

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: I observed several promising sites below the surface, but we'll need to construct a way for everyone to climb safely down this cliff. Perhaps we could safely build platforms?
spirals.zh: PLUME: I observed several promising sites below the surface, but we’ll need to construct a way for everyone to climb safely down this cliff. Perhaps we could build platforms?

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: Use caution! A black hole sleeps below. You must not slip.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：当心！下方沉睡着一个黑洞。千万不要失足。

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: Of note: Be sure not to wander far from here. Though this area is somewhat unstable, it's safer than any we've found so far.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：注意：务必不要走远。这片区域虽有些不稳定，但仍是我们目前能找到最安全的地方。

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: The temporary settlement is finished, but remember to be cautious of falling rocks and dust caused by meteor impacts.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：临时庇护所已经建好，但请记得留意撞击产生的落石和尘埃。

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: This knowledge is too dear to lose: Here is everything we recall about the signal we encountered while aboard the Vessel.
spirals.zh: THATCH: This knowledge is too dear to lose: Here is everything we can recall about the signal we encountered while aboard the Vessel.

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: The signal looked like an eye: Round, with a circle at the centre much like a pupil. (Suppose the signal was looking for something.)
spirals.zh: FILIX: The signal looked like an eye: round, with a circle at the center much like a pupil. (Suppose the signal was looking for something.)

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: The signal was older than the universe itself! This is the most significant detail.
spirals.zh: FILIX: The signal was older than the universe itself! This is the most significant detail.

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: No Nomai clan has ever encountered anything like it! How can anything in this universe be older than the universe itself?
spirals.zh: PLUME: No Nomai clan has ever encountered anything like it! How can anything in this universe be older than the universe itself?

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Imagine what rare and profound knowledge it might offer. We *must* find this Eye of the universe.
spirals.zh: THATCH: Imagine what rare and profound knowledge it might offer. We must find this Eye of the universe.

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: I can't understand. Why did the Vessel crash in that place?
spirals.zh: 萨奇：我实在想不通。母舰为什么会坠毁在那个地方？

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: Was the Vessel unwell in some way?
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：母舰是不是哪儿出了毛病？

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: No, Annona and I checked before the warp, and the warp core and navigation systems were both well.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：不，跃迁之前安诺纳和我做过检查，跃迁核心和导航系统都好着呢。

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: We warped to follow that curious signal from the eye of the universe. Where we arrived was wrong; it wasn't where we tried to go.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：我们是跟着宇宙之眼发出的神秘信号进行跃迁的。然而，我们抵达的地点却完全错了——那根本不是我们原本想要前往的目的地。

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Suppose it wasn't a problem with the Vessel, but with our destination.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：假设不是母舰出了问题，而是我们的目的地出了问题。

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: I'm afraid for our friends in escape pod 3…
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：我很担心我们在3号逃生舱里的朋友们……

spirals.speaker: KOUSA
spirals.text: We can hear the other escape pod’s distress signals, which gives me hope. Foli, are you still here? I am unsure how to survive in this place without you.
spirals.zh: KOUSA: We can hear the other escape pods’ distress signals, which gives me hope. Foli, are you still here? I am unsure how to survive in this place without you.

spirals.speaker: KOUSA
spirals.text: (I am unsure how to be me without you.)
spirals.zh: KOUSA: (I am unsure how to be me without you.)

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: My brother wasn't in escape pod 1 with us. Was he in pod 2, or pod 3? Was he able to board an escape pod at all?
spirals.zh: PLUME: My brother wasn’t in Escape Pod 1 with us. Was he in Pod 2, or Pod 3? Was he able to board an escape pod at all?

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: We sacrificed too much arriving here. I cannot (I *will* not) allow our clan's greatest loss to be in vain.
spirals.zh: PLUME: We sacrificed too much arriving here. I cannot (I will not) allow our clan’s greatest loss to be in vain.

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Is the hardest part of this tragedy not knowing who we may have lost? Or will the hardest part come later, when we learn? (Be well, aunt Melorae...)
spirals.zh: THATCH: Is the hardest part of this tragedy not knowing who we may have lost? Or will the hardest part come later, when we learn? (Be well, Aunt Melorae...)

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: The pain of your absence is sharp and haunting, and I would give anything not to know it; anything but never knowing you at all (which would be worse).
spirals.zh: PLUME: The pain of your absence is sharp and haunting, and I would give anything not to know it; anything but never knowing you at all (which would be worse).

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: I can only hope that you are safe, Keek, wherever you are.
