spirals.text: Yes, the probe must travel as fast as the can, as far as it can. I'll make some adjustments!
spirals.zh: MALLOW: Yes, the probe must travel as fast as it can, as far as it can. I’ll make some adjustments!

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: This is troublesome. It seems the comet wishes to submerge our shuttle in ice. If we stay on the surface too long, the shuttle may freeze entirely.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：这有些麻烦：这颗彗星似乎想把我们的航天飞机埋进冰里。如果我们在表面停留太久，航天飞机可能会完全冻住。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Even if it did, couldn’t someone call it back home to the gravity cannon on Ember Twin?
spirals.zh: 珀克：就算真的冻住了，不也可以让某个人从余烬双星的重力炮那里把它召回去吗？

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Yes, but the exploration of the comet would be more difficult if we were without the shuttle until someone recalled it. Perhaps we shouldn’t have landed on the dark side of the comet…
spirals.zh: 派伊：可以，但在有人召回它之前，如果我们没了航天飞机，探索彗星会困难得多。或许我们不该降落在彗星的背阴面……

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Suppose one of us remained in the shuttle to keep it warm and continue monitoring the surface.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：设若我们之中有一个人留在航天飞机里，负责维持温度，并继续监测表面情况。

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: This would be wise, I think, Clary. If you don’t mind waiting here with it, Poke and I can continue to investigate the surface.
spirals.zh: 派伊：我认为这很明智，克莱瑞。如果你不介意在这里和它一起等待，珀克和我可以继续调查表面。

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: I fear our situation may be dire:
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：恐怕我们的处境可能十分严峻：

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Poke, Pye and I landed here on this comet not long after its arrival in this star system. Our shuttle’s equipment heard strange energy readings coming from somewhere beneath the surface.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：这颗彗星抵达这个星系后不久，派伊、珀克和我就在这里着陆了。我们的航天飞机设备侦测到，从地表下方某处传来了奇怪的能量读数。

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Pye and Poke were able to locate a fissure in the ice on the comet's sunward side, and they descended inside to investigate the source of the readings.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：派伊和珀克在彗星向阳面的冰层上找到了一道裂隙，随后深入其中，调查读数的来源。

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: But… Pye and my sister have been gone for a long time now. They haven't contacted me since descending below the surface, either.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：可是……派伊和我的姐妹（珀克）已经离开很久了。自从深入地表以下之后，她们也没有再联系过我。

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Should I leave the shuttle to look for them? I want to follow protocol, but I don't know what I'll do if they aren't well…
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：我应该离开航天飞机去找她们吗？我想遵守规程，但如果她们出了事，我不知道自己会怎么办……

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Poke… Pye… Come back to me safely, my friends.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：珀克……派伊……平安回到我身边吧，我的朋友们。

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: I’m receiving much stronger energy readings now that we’re beneath the crust. Whatever it is must lie somewhere below, closer to the comet’s center. And I’m starting to think it’s more dangerous than we realized.
spirals.zh: 派伊：现在我们已经来到地壳之下，接收到的能量读数强烈得多了。不管那是什么，一定就在下方某处，更靠近彗星的中心。而且我开始觉得，它比我们原先意识到的还要危险。

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Clary, can you hear us?
spirals.zh: 派伊：克莱瑞，你能听见我们吗？

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Yes, but your voices are faint. I fear we will lose communication entirely if you continue any deeper.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：能，但你们的声音很微弱。恐怕你们要是继续深入，我们就会彻底失去联系。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Keep the shuttle warm for us, Clary. We’ll return the moment we identify the source of the energy readings!
spirals.zh: 珀克：克莱瑞，替我们保持航天飞机的温度。我们一确认能量读数的源头，就立刻回来！

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: I understand, but… Be cautious, both of you.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：我明白，但是……你们两个，一定要小心。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: The spherical stone casing here seems to be the source of the energy readings… No, rather, the source is what’s within the stone. I’m detecting some form of exotic matter.
spirals.zh: 珀克：这里这个球形岩石壳体似乎就是能量读数的源头……不，更准确地说，源头是石头里面的东西。我检测到了某种奇异物质。

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: The stone is *muting* our energy readings; they should be ten times what we’re seeing, at least.
spirals.zh: 派伊：这层岩壳正在削弱我们的能量读数；真实读数至少应该是现在的十倍。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Pye, I don’t think we want this matter interacting with us. As far as I can tell, direct contact with it would almost certainly be fatal.
spirals.zh: 珀克：派伊，我觉得我们不会想让这种物质接触我们。据我判断，直接暴露在它之下几乎必定会致命。

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: I’ve never encountered anything like this casing, but it’s all that’s protecting us from what’s inside. Worse still, this matter is disturbingly volatile.
spirals.zh: 派伊：我从未见过像这样的岩石壳体，但它却是唯一将我们与内容物隔开的屏障。更糟的是，这种物质不稳定得令人不安。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: ...Pye. Whatever the matter inside this stone casing is, it’s more than just profoundly unstable; it’s under tonnes of pressure. Look at this density scan. I’ve never seen *anything* this tightly compacted before! What *is* this?
spirals.zh: 珀克：……派伊。不管这个岩石壳体里的物质是什么，它不只是极度不稳定而已；它还承受着数以吨计的压力。看这份密度扫描。我从没见过任何被压缩得这么紧密的东西！这究竟是什么？

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: This is orders of magnitude worse than I’d imagined. If this stone were to rupture, the lethal matter within would rapidly expand, completely blanketing this star system almost instantaneously. And the pressure is building as the comet approaches the sun...
spirals.zh: 派伊：这比我想象的还要糟糕好几个数量级。如果这块石头破裂，里面的致命物质就会迅速膨胀，几乎在一瞬间完全笼罩整个星系。而且随着彗星接近这个星系，压力还在继续升高……

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Return to the shuttle, right now! The rest of our friends need to know they’re in terrible danger. Leave your equipment and run!
spirals.zh: 派伊：立刻回航天飞机去！其他朋友必须知道自己正处在极度危险之中。丢下设备，快跑！

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: What are you doing, Pye?!
spirals.zh: 珀克：你在做什么，派伊？！

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: The more we know about this alien matter, the better our chances of survival. I will learn what I can here. Go warn the others; maybe they can construct shelter somehow. ...*Now*, Poke!
spirals.zh: 派伊：我们越了解这种异星物质，幸存的机会就越大。我来尽力把它弄明白。快去，去警告其他人；也许大家还能设法建造庇护所。……走啊，珀克！

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Welcome to the White Hole Station! Did you fall through the black hole by accident? (Don’t worry; you aren’t the first.) You can use this warp tower to return to Brittle Hollow.
spirals.zh: 珀克：欢迎来到白洞站！如果你不小心掉进了黑洞（别担心，你不是第一个），这座跃迁塔可以把你送回碎空星。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Warp towers work like this: Stand in the middle of the platform on the floor, look up, and wait.

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: The path opens when the tower’s corresponding astral body (in this case, Brittle Hollow) is directly overhead.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: Our escape pod crashed as we tried to flee this place, destroying our movement and communication abilities in the process.
spirals.zh: SECCA: Our escape pod crashed as we tried to flee this place, destroying our movement and communication capabilities in the process.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: We’ve held out for as long as we could here, but this pod’s supply of breathable air is nearly depleted, and the anglerfish attack more and more frequently.
spirals.zh: SECCA: We’ve held out as long as we could here, but this pod’s supply of breathable air is nearly depleted, and the anglerfish attack more and more frequently.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: Our best chance at survival is to return to the Vessel to either repair the damage, or, more probably, await rescue.
spirals.zh: SECCA: Our best chance at survival is to return to the Vessel to either repair the damage or, more probably, await rescue.

spirals.speaker: ESCALL
spirals.text: Secca, is the message finished? The Vessel’s beacon is already growing fainter; it will be gone in a matter of hours. We need to leave here, quickly.
spirals.zh: ESCALL: Secca, is the message finished? The Vessel’s beacon is already growing fainter; it will be gone in a matter of hours. We need to leave here, quickly.

spirals.speaker: DIN
spirals.text: There is a new problem: our equipment is detecting two distinct beacons from the Vessel.
spirals.zh: DIN: There is a new problem: Our equipment is detecting two distinct beacons from the Vessel.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: But it isn’t possible for the Vessel to be in two different locations at the same time.
spirals.zh: SECCA: But it isn’t possible for the Vessel to be in two different locations at the same time.

spirals.speaker: DIN
spirals.text: I agree, but the beacons are exactly identical to each other. Perhaps if I had more time-
spirals.zh: DIN: I agree, but the beacons are exactly identical to each other. Perhaps if I had more time —

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: We’re nearly out of time already, Din; the Vessel’s beacon is quickly fading. Soon, it will be gone, and we will be lost.
spirals.zh: SECCA: We’re nearly out of time already, Din; the Vessel’s beacon is quickly fading. Soon, it will be gone, and we will be lost.

spirals.speaker: ESCALL
spirals.text: We will follow the beacon whose source is closest to us.
spirals.zh: ESCALL: We will follow the beacon whose source is nearest to us.

spirals.speaker: DIN
spirals.text: But suppose that beacon is false!
spirals.zh: DIN: But suppose that beacon is false!

spirals.speaker: ESCALL
spirals.text: We likely don’t have enough air to reach the farther of the two beacons, Din. The decision is made for us.
spirals.zh: ESCALL: We likely don’t have enough air to reach the farther of the two beacons, Din. The decision is made for us.

spirals.speaker: ESCALL
spirals.text: We’ll leave a trail of lights as we go. There’s still a chance someone could hear our escape pod’s distress signal.
spirals.zh: ESCALL: We’ll leave a trail of lights as we go. There’s still a chance someone could hear our escape pod’s distress signal.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: To any who come here searching for us: we followed one of the two beacons from the Vessel to this place, but now can go no further.
spirals.zh: SECCA: To any who come here searching for us: We followed one of the two beacons from the Vessel to this place, but now can go no further.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: It’s almost too faint to hear now, but the Vessel’s beacon is still faintly emitting from within this thorny seed. Yet the opening is too small for a single Nomai to fit through, so our escape pod couldn’t have flown through here.
spirals.zh: SECCA: It's almost too faint to hear now, but the Vessel’s beacon is still faintly emitting from within this thorny seed. Yet the opening is too small for even a single Nomai to fit through it, so our escape pod couldn’t have flown through here.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: I don’t understand how this could be possible, but this gruesome place seems able to manipulate space itself; maybe this was our undoing.
spirals.zh: SECCA: I don’t understand how this could be possible, but this gruesome place seems able to manipulate space itself; maybe this was our undoing.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: To be so close to the location of the Vessel and still so far is… difficult. Worse, the Vessel’s beacon is dying; soon, we will be unable to hear it.
spirals.zh: SECCA: To be so close to the location of the Vessel and still so far is... difficult. Worse, the Vessel’s beacon is dying; soon, we will be unable to hear it.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: There is nothing we can do now but try to perhaps find a way inside, or at least attempt to comprehend why this happened.
spirals.zh: SECCA: There is nothing we can do now but try to perhaps find a way inside, or at least attempt to comprehend why this happened.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: My dearest hope is that the other escape pods were able to reach relative safety.
spirals.zh: SECCA: My dearest hope is that the other escape pods were able to reach relative safety.

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: I’m recording now - I’ve never encountered anything like this! The signal the Vessel is receiving seems to be *older than the universe itself*!
spirals.zh: FILIX: I’m recording now — I’ve never encountered anything like this! The signal the Vessel is receiving appears to be older than the universe itself!

spirals.speaker: ESCALL
spirals.text: This is our first contact with anything of this nature. Everyone, prepare to warp immediately!
spirals.zh: ESCALL: This is our first contact with anything of this nature. Everyone, prepare to warp immediately!

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: Escall, wait! I need more time to send an outgoing message! Shouldn’t we tell another clan where we’re going?
spirals.zh: FILIX: Escall, wait, I need more time to send an outgoing message! Shouldn’t we tell another clan where we’re going?

spirals.speaker: ESCALL
spirals.text: We can send the message on arrival. This extraordinary signal appeared suddenly; it may disappear just as quickly, and we can’t lose a discovery this incredible! Focus on preparing for the warp, instead.
spirals.zh: ESCALL: We can send the message upon our arrival. This extraordinary signal appeared suddenly; it may disappear just as quickly, and we can’t lose a discovery this incredible! Focus on preparing for the warp, instead.

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: I understand!
spirals.zh: FILIX: I understand!

spirals.speaker: ESCALL
spirals.text: Annona, is the Vessel ready to warp to the signal’s approximate coordinates?
spirals.zh: ESCALL: Annona, is the Vessel ready to warp to the signal’s approximate coordinates?

spirals.speaker: ANNONA
spirals.text: The warp core is powered, but this will be a significant jump. Afterward, we’ll need time to recharge the core.
spirals.zh: ANNONA: The warp core is powered, but this will be a significant jump. Afterward, we’ll need time to recharge the core.

spirals.speaker: ESCALL
spirals.text: That shouldn’t create a problem, provided we arrive at or near the signal’s source. Everyone, we’re ready to warp!
spirals.zh: ESCALL: That shouldn’t create a problem, provided we arrive at or near the signal’s source. Everyone, we’re ready to warp!

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: This is Escall’s Vessel; something went badly wrong during our warp, and our Vessel is mortally wounded. We need help as quickly as possible!
spirals.zh: FILIX: This is Escall’s Vessel; something went badly wrong during our warp, and our Vessel is mortally wounded. We need help as quickly as possible!

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: Our Vessel appears to have… has it *fused* with the local environment, somehow? There are vines that are now part of the Vessel! It’s been torn apart from inside itself!
spirals.zh: FILIX: Our Vessel appears to have... has it fused with the local environment, somehow? There are vines that are now part of the Vessel! It’s been torn apart from inside itself!

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: We… we are abandoning our Vessel. Any Nomai clans or spaceflight-capable species receiving, I implore you, we need your help!
spirals.zh: FILIX: We... we are abandoning our Vessel. Any Nomai clans or spaceflight-capable species receiving this message, I implore you, we need your help!

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: Is this broken? Can anyone hear me? Our Vessel is dying! We need immediate assistance!
spirals.zh: FILIX: Is this broken? Can anyone hear me? Our Vessel is dying! We need immediate assistance!

spirals.speaker: CANNA
spirals.text: To any Nomai Clans whose Vessels can hear this message:
spirals.zh: CANNA: To any Nomai clans whose Vessels can hear this message:

spirals.speaker: CANNA
spirals.text: It’s clear the universe is dying. There are fewer and fewer resources and safe places within space now, so my clan and I believe the best option is for all of our clans to stay together.
spirals.zh: CANNA: It’s clear the universe is dying. There are fewer and fewer resources and safe places within space now, so my clan and I believe the best option is for all of our clans to stay together.

spirals.speaker: CANNA
spirals.text: If you can reach the Gloaming Galaxy, we’ve found that Blackrock’s suns are fairly stable, and life in this star system is (comparatively) thriving. We live in relative safety.
spirals.zh: CANNA: If you can reach the Gloaming Galaxy, we’ve found that Blackrock’s suns are fairly stable, and life in this star system is (comparatively) thriving. We live in relative safety.

spirals.speaker: BROMI
spirals.text: Canna, we’re making our way to you.
spirals.zh: BROMI: Canna, we’re making our way to you.

spirals.speaker: CANNA
spirals.text: Has anyone heard from Neem? His clan was on its way to our Vessel, but they never arrived, and he hasn’t sent any messages. I’m beginning to worry.
spirals.zh: CANNA: Has anyone heard from Neem? His clan was on its way to our Vessel, but they never arrived, and he hasn’t sent any messages. I’m beginning to worry.

spirals.speaker: BROMI
spirals.text: That *is* unsettling. It reminds me of that old myth my grandfather used to tell, the Disappearance of Escall.
spirals.zh: BROMI: That is unsettling. It reminds me of that old myth my grandfather used to tell, the Disappearance of Escall.

spirals.speaker: CLEM
spirals.text: I remember hearing that story as a child! One day, Escall’s Vessel simply stopped responding. The other clans searched and searched, but found no trace. It was as if their missing friends had warped out of existence.
spirals.zh: CLEM: I remember hearing that story as a child! One day, Escall’s Vessel simply stopped responding. The other clans searched and searched, but found no trace. It was as if their missing friends had warped out of existence.

spirals.speaker: HYSSOP
spirals.text: That’s no myth, friends: Escall’s clan existed, and their story was real.
spirals.zh: HYSSOP: That’s no myth, friends; Escall’s clan existed, and their story was real.

spirals.speaker: BROMI
spirals.text: What a curious event to have passed into myth! Our ancestors’ ancestors were told that story when they were young. Are you sure it’s true, Hyssop?
spirals.zh: BROMI: What a curious event to have passed into myth! Our ancestors’ ancestors were told that story when they were young. Are you sure it’s true, Hyssop?

spirals.speaker: HYSSOP
spirals.text: It was a very long time ago, but yes. My clan’s ancestors searched for Escall’s clan for a long time, but in the end, none of them were ever seen again. (It’s the only time a Vessel has ever disappeared in this way.)
spirals.zh: HYSSOP: It was a very long time ago, but yes. My clan’s ancestors searched for Escall’s clan for a long time, but in the end, none of them were ever seen again. (It’s the only time in our history a Vessel has ever disappeared this way.)

spirals.speaker: NEEM
spirals.text: Hyssop, I hope you aren’t comparing Escall’s story to my clan’s vessel!
spirals.zh: NEEM: Hyssop, I hope you aren’t comparing Escall’s story to my clan’s Vessel!

spirals.speaker: CLEM
spirals.text: Neem, my friend! We feared you were gone!
spirals.zh: CLEM: Neem, my friend! We feared you were gone!

spirals.speaker: NEEM
spirals.text: Not yet, we aren’t, but nearly. We found trouble during our warp: the triple suns of the Bright Spark star system exploded, and it was only a lucky coincidence we weren’t caught in the blast. We’ll meet you soon, Canna!
spirals.zh: NEEM: Not yet, we aren’t, but nearly. We found trouble during our warp: The triple suns of the Bright Spark star system exploded, and it was only a lucky coincidence we weren’t caught in the blast. We’ll meet you soon, Canna!

spirals.speaker: CANNA
spirals.text: I’m relieved your clan is safe, Neem! It’s good to hear your words. Any clan nearby, remember to be extremely cautious of potentially unstable stars (which is most of them, now).
spirals.zh: CANNA: I’m relieved your clan is safe, Neem! It’s good to hear your words. Any Vessels nearby, remember to be extremely cautious of potentially unstable stars (which is most of them, now).
